response.sql: WITH station_stats AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS station_avg_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t INNER JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, AVG(station_avg_usage) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, SUM(telescope_count) AS telescope_count, 1.0 * SUM(telescope_count) / SUM(SUM(telescope_count)) OVER () AS telescope_fraction FROM station_stats GROUP BY lunarstage
